claims: The article separates central, two-body spin-orbit and tensor contributions to cross-shell monopole matrix elements in SDPF-MU.
ESPE and shell-gap changes are diagnostics derived from monopole matrix-element differences, not direct observables.
Ca/K spectroscopic distributions and level trends constrain different parts of the shell-evolution argument, with model dependence and missing-strength limits.
The N=32 spin-orbit reduction retains a Woods-Saxon weak-binding interpretation as a competing explanation.
